attempts.exactPrompt:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Oris Falai: 30-year-old man, 195 cm (very-tall), conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition, skin value band-3-light-medium. Face: long narrow face; close-set eyes and a high arched brow; broad low bridge, full lips; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blonde-gold, bob-pageboy, deliberate accent: sharply stepped fringe. Wardrobe: asymmetric-patchwork, specifically intentional patchwork layers with an uneven hem, visible repairs, and practical trousers; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette teal-brown. Visible personal details: no accessory and no tattoo. Make repair, patina, customization, or a keepsake the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: meticulous daily maintenance. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: one thumb hooks lightly beneath the waist wrap while the other hand rests open. Include a wooden thread gauge only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme. Do not copy the reference's person, braid, clothes, pose, palette, progression, identity, body, hair, garments, ornaments, or markings.

RESERVE ACTIVATION: This is a fresh base summon, not an edit or regeneration of any existing hero. Create the new identity described above using only the authorized rendering-style reference. Honor the complete activated physical manifest and reserve character kernel; no failed hero or failed candidate is a visual source.

findings.observation: Exactly one coherent 30-year-old adult man appears, with one head, two natural arms, two readable hands, two legs, and no additional subject or duplicated anatomy.

Original-resolution inspection confirms the complete pageboy hair, head, both hands, thread gauge, asymmetric hems, trouser legs, boots, and both feet remain fully inside generous top, side, and bottom margins.

Visible brush planes, controlled illustrative facial modeling, matte skin, textured repaired cloth, warm parchment wash, and soft grounding shadow establish a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing without photography, plastic 3D, or cel-anime finish.

The very-tall athletic adult, light-medium skin, long narrow face, close-set eyes, arched brow, broad low bridge, full lips, blonde-gold bob-pageboy, teal-brown repaired patchwork layers, broad folded collar, uneven divided hem, practical trousers, and wooden thread gauge are legible with no tattoo or ornament. However, the fringe is an essentially continuous blunt curve rather than the required sharply stepped accent, the waist hand grips cloth instead of clearly hooking one thumb beneath the wrap, and the gauge hand is closed around the object rather than resting open.
The mouth is closed and unsmiling, with a calm reserved gaze and no grin or theatrical acting.

The visibly repaired patchwork cloth, practical trousers, worn boots, and wooden thread gauge remain ordinary mortal details. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, or text appears.

The long-faced blonde man, pageboy silhouette, teal-brown patchwork workwear, wooden gauge, and grounded stance do not reproduce the reference woman, heavy braid, ochre progression clothing, face, anatomy, or pose; only the authorized painterly register and parchment presentation carry over.
